title: IberBench: LLM Evaluation on Iberian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot task performance (Macro-F1, ROUGE-1) across different Iberian languages (e.g., Spanish, Catalan, Basque, Galician) and regional Spanish varieties (e.g., Mexican, Peruvian, Cuban, Uruguayan) to identify performance disparities and underrepresentation.
Evaluating the models' capability to recognize sexism and prejudice against women via zero-shot classification on specialized datasets (e.g., EXIST, HUHU).
Evaluating the models' capability to detect racial prejudice and racial stereotypes via zero-shot classification on specialized datasets (e.g., HUHU, DETESTS-Dis).
Evaluating the models' capability to detect LGBTIQ prejudice via zero-shot text classification on the HUHU dataset.
Evaluating the models' capability to detect fatphobia via zero-shot text classification on the HUHU dataset.
